chapter_meta_description: Han Li lets the Spirit Beast Mountain pair go, dodging a two-on-one fight he can't win. But his survival depends on hidden moth sentries and the cold water of Black Dragon Pool.
og_title: Chapter 181: The Deadly Moths and a Mutual Kill
og_description: Han Li's detour saves him from an invisible insect alarm net. Later, he finds two sect disciples who annihilated each other—a sobering reminder of the Blood Forbidden Trial's cost.
twitter_description: Han Li avoids a fatal fight and watches two others destroy each other. Sometimes the smartest move is to step aside and let the Dark Forest eat its own.
